articles.title: Freedom 250: IndyCar Roars Through D.C. Streets
articles.summary: Trump and Melania watch IndyCar race through D.C. streets at 200 mph. It's part of America's 250th birthday celebrations, but critics say he's distracted from bigger issues.

articles.title: Hawaii Braces for Another Storm as Moke Approaches
articles.summary: Tropical Storm Moke threatens Hawaii with up to 15 inches of rain, just days after Hurricane Lala caused flooding. Residents are preparing for more damage.

articles.title: Macron Hosts Saudi Crown Prince for Talks on Energy and Conflict
articles.summary: Saudi Crown Prince MBS visits Paris for talks with Macron on energy, regional conflicts, and cooperation. They'll also attend the Esports World Cup final.
